newsitem.title: GERMANY: POLL - analysts see no Buba rate cut, slower Jan M3.
newsitem.headline: POLL - analysts see no Buba rate cut, slower Jan M3.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting and on the outlook for January M3 data. The poll was conducted on Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank cut its leading interest rates this
week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a further cut in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 2
No 8
3. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll follow:
Economist 1. 2. 3.
Gertrud Traud, Bank Julius Baer No. No. Yes.
Rolf Schneider, Dresdner Bank No. No. Yes.
David Brown, Bear Sterns, London No. Yes. Yes.
Holger Fahrinkrug, UBS, Frankfurt No. No. Yes.
Stephen Lewis, London Bond Broking No. No. Yes.
Philip Tyson, HSBC Markets, London No. No. Yes.
Norbert Meissner, Caisse des Depots No. No. Yes.
Peter Gutmann, Nat West Bank, London No. No. Yes
Stefan Scheider, Banque Paibas No. No. Yes
Wilfried Bock, Norddt. Landesbank No. Yes. Yes.
4. What is your forecast for January M3 growth?
Economist vs Q4 1995 vs Q4 1996
